offers_products.reason: Sells MX Merchant and MX POS software, payments platform and APIs as core offerings.

offers_services.reason: Payment processing, merchant services, banking and payables automation are ongoing services to merchants.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are merchants, ISOs, ISVs, and businesses; no direct household buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to merchants, retailers, manufacturers, sports venues, ISOs and fintechs.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes from ongoing per-transaction processing fees from merchants, with about 3.7K new merchants monthly.

cyclical_demand.reason: Payment processing is tied to merchant activity and can't be easily postponed, though volumes soften somewhat.

big_ticket.reason: Small, frequent transaction fees and subscriptions, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for payment technology and banking platform, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Mainly small and mid-sized merchants and ISO partners, though large enterprises are also served.

asset_heavy.reason: Software and payments platform needing technology investment, not plants, fleets or properties.

notes: Customer size is mixed (small merchants plus some enterprises); judged mainly small and mid-sized.
